scope: Current Marion County nutrition incentives and Indiana reentry resources

records.name: Fresh Bucks Indy
records.description: Marion County nutrition incentive program that matches eligible SNAP purchases for fresh fruits, vegetables, herbs, edible plants, and seedlings at participating retailers, farmers markets, and farm stands.
records.availability_notes: Participating locations and seasonal market dates change. Farmers markets must already accept SNAP before applying to distribute Fresh Bucks; produce vendors may separately apply to accept Fresh Bucks. Verified August 3, 2026.

records.name: Marion County Produce Prescription (Rx) Program
records.description: County-wide Food as Medicine initiative that enables participating healthcare professionals to refer eligible patients for nutrition education and produce-purchase benefits.
records.availability_notes: Referral based through participating healthcare systems and providers; not open self-enrollment. Current clinic partnerships and redemption sites must be verified before referral. Verified August 3, 2026.

records.name: Hoosier Initiative for Re-Entry (HIRE)
records.description: Indiana Department of Correction program providing job readiness, résumé and interview assistance, digital and financial literacy, employer matching, pre-release interviews, and post-release employment support.
records.availability_notes: Coordinator assignments and contact details are update-sensitive. Marion County is currently served by HIRE Region 5B. Verified August 3, 2026.

records.name: IDOC Indianapolis Parole District 3
records.description: Marion County parole office providing supervision, transition support, reentry contacts, HIRE coordination, healthcare transition facilitation, and community-based service connections.
records.availability_notes: Office hours, supervisors, HIRE coordinator, and transitional healthcare facilitator are update-sensitive. Verified August 3, 2026.
